title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the differential cross section must be correctly stated.

title: Use of Reduced Mass
description: Important Criteria: The reduced mass of the nucleon and nucleus must be correctly identified and used in calculations.

title: Correct Integration
description: Important Criteria: The integral involving the potential V(r) and the sine function must be correctly set up and evaluated.

title: Expression for q
description: Important Criteria: The expression for q in terms of k and theta must be correctly derived and utilized.

title: Trigonometric Identities
description: Optional Criteria: Appropriate trigonometric identities should be applied to simplify the final expression if necessary.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include sign mistakes in the potential or during integration.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
